title: Build a social media content calendar you can keep up with
seoTitle: Social media content calendar: free template
description: Build a social media content calendar from real customer questions. Get a weekly rhythm, a month template, AI prompts per platform and a review routine.
lede: A social media content calendar is a plan of what you'll post, where and when. Build it from the questions your customers actually ask, keep a posting rhythm you can realistically manage, and let AI draft the individual posts. This guide gives you the template, three prompts and a monthly routine.
keywords: plan social media posts with AI
